Subject: Multi-app Expansion & Staged Key Provisioning for Nexcentric — Rollout Timeline

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the catch-up last week. Per our conversation, Nexcentric is ready to bring three additional apps (Search, Recommendations, and Support Chat) onto the platform. I put together a short operational playbook (attached) and a proposed staging plan below so we can align on timing and credentials.

Quick ask: can you confirm the internal owners for each app (names + Slack handles) so we can whitelist them for key access? Once we have owners, we’ll provision keys in a staggered fashion and set per-key quotas to match your peak traffic windows.

Proposed phased rollout (high level):
- Phase A (Week 1): Provision dev & staging keys for Search and Recommendations; basic test harness and smoke tests.
- Phase B (Week 2–3): Production keys for Search (limited quota), infra monitoring hooks + alerting.
- Phase C (Week 4): Production keys for Recommendations and Support Chat; enable burst capacity and caching profiles.
- Phase D (Week 6): Full traffic ramp and baseline commit for committed units (monthly).

Attachments: nexcentric-mop-v1.pdf (playbook), nexcentric-key-provisioning-sheet.csv (key mapping + quotas)

Next steps:
1) Confirm app owners (reply to this thread)
2) Kickoff call to lock exact dates (I’m proposing Tue 11/9 10am PT)
3) Sign the short addendum (I’ll push a DocuSign link once we confirm scope)

Will loop in Ben (technical ops) and Monica (onboarding) on provisioning actions.

Thanks,

On Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 08:42 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:

Alex —

Thanks for the owners — that helps. Quick answers inline: 

1) Quotas/burst: default per-key baseline will be 1k req/min with burst to 5k req/min for short windows. We’ll configure adaptive burst windows tied to observed traffic; Ben will instrument rate-limit metrics so you can see consumption per key in the Console.

2) Billing: we recommend consolidating under your existing commit and adding a +20% top-up for the month of full ramp to cover burst and cache-warm costs. If you prefer a separate commit for the Support Chat app (given sensitive data flows) we can do that as an addendum.

3) SOC 2 & diagrams: attaching SOC2 summary link in the drive folder and including an export of our architecture diagram in the playbook.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & owners (5)
- Rollout phases & timing (8)
- Key provisioning & safelist process (7)
- Monitoring + SLA/alerts (5)
- Next steps / DocuSign addendum (5)

I’ll attach a DocuSign link by EOD after we agree scope (expecting a short addendum to extend apps and adjust commit). Calendar invite incoming.

— Jordan

Alex / Jordan —

Two operational notes from the provisioning side: 
- Key safelisting: For each app owner, we need a primary IP CIDR (or OAuth client id) to bind keys; if you want to use dynamic hosts we can instead enforce mTLS or VPC-only routing for the Support Chat service.
- Quota shaping: We’ll create per-key usage tiers in the Console and pre-seed a short-lived dev key set so your QA can run realistic load tests.

Alex —

Great — mTLS for Support Chat and CIDR for the other two apps is fine. Artifacts and answers below: 
- Data retention: our default retention for request logs is 90 days; we offer an enterprise option for 365 days (we can enable per-account). See Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Nexcentric-Enablement (file: data-retention-summary.pdf)
- Audit logs/access: we expose a daily audit export (S3) and Console-level role-based access; SOC 2 report linked in the same folder.
- Billing top-up: the +20% is applied as a one-time invoice at the start of the first full month after production ramp (prorated if ramp happens mid-month).

DocuSign: https://docusign.company/secure/NX-3241-addendum (short addendum to extend scope + update commit).

Meeting confirmed: Tue 11/9 10:00 AM PT (30 min). Attendees: Jordan, Ben, Monica, Alex, Priya, Omar. Agenda will be as previously shared.

Immediate action items assigned: 
- Alex: share CIDR blocks for Search & Recommendations and mTLS cert owner for Support Chat (by 11/10 EOD).
- Monica: prepare QA dev keys and test harness (deliverable: dev key creds by 11/10 EOD).
- Ben: pre-seed quota profiles and enable Console alerts for per-key thresholds (by 11/12).

If you want the security pack (extended retention + audit export), Marissa will prepare pricing options post-call.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.
